opening.argument: The presentation promotes BC Trader as an exclusive BitClub Network product, directs buyers to watch the webinar, and requires a $500 license together with $2,000 in a trading account. It asks users to connect an exchange API key while describing the software as “tested” and “proven,” and it links multiple licenses to the ability to trade larger sums. It also presents profit-related performance claims, including an expectation of profit after one year. Although it acknowledges that some users may see poor gains and shows a test account losing 1%, those qualifications do not remove the financial risk of the promotional scheme. The evidence establishes solicitation and risk, without establishing purchases, deposits, API permissions, or completed losses.
